svg.title: Fault distance of Carbon-Helix adaptive rules

cc:Work.dc:title: Fault distance of Carbon-Helix adaptive rules
cc:Work.dc:description: Unit chart, one bead per fault. All 16 R8 cases are proven at distance 11 or 12; four other rule cases are proven at 11 or 12 and one (quiet, X) is 11 but incomplete. Alternative outer-check circuits reach 9 to 11. The whole-circuit search proved only lower bounds of 4 and 5 against best found 12 and 11. Distance 11 or more means at least six faults per logical error.
